entities.name: Friedrich August Marschall von Bieberstein
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Baron Friedrich August Marschall von Bieberstein  was an early explorer of the flora and archeology of the southern portion of Imperial Russia, including the Caucasus and Novorossiya. He compiled the first comprehensive flora catalogue of the Crimeo-Caucasian region.
